title: Beta builds — moved to Development, and onto the update popup

steps.headline: The beta switch is in Development now, not About.
steps.changed: It sits under its own Updates heading, below the four rows that were already there. About is back to exactly what it was before this work.
steps.measured: 1 heading, 1 line of text, 1 switch; 0 changes to About
steps.notice: The four rows above it all open something somewhere else. This one decides something on the spot, which is why it is under a heading of its own rather than fifth in that list.
steps.risk: Development reads as a place for reporting bugs and contributing, so someone hunting for update settings may still look in About first and find nothing.

steps.path: The version pill at the bottom, then the update popup
steps.headline: The same switch sits under the release notes, where you read what a new version contains.
steps.changed: A rule, then the switch, at the end of the popup's scroll. It appears in both states of that popup — under "What's new" when you are current, and under the notes when an update is waiting.
steps.notice: This is the moment you are already thinking about versions, so turning betas on or off does not mean going and finding a settings screen.
steps.risk: It is below the notes, so on a release with long notes you scroll past everything to reach it. Putting it above them would push the thing you opened the popup for down the page.
